description: Councils ranked on one measure across the UK, a nation or an English region, for the latest period. Measures each nation makes its own way (such as deprivation) are ranked within one nation only.

layer.description: A layer id or slug, such as house-price-average or house-prices.

place.description: Optional: also say where this council sits.

scope.description: uk, a nation (england, wales, scotland, northern-ireland) or an English region (london, north-west...). Default uk.

name: get_ranking
title: Rank councils
